## Change

Describe the user-visible outcome and why it is useful.

## Evidence

For catalog or adapter changes, link official upstream documentation and record the checked version or commit. Disclose any affiliation with the proposed tool.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Distinguish configuration tests, MCP protocol checks, and hands-on agent validation.

- [ ] Scope is focused and descriptions explain a concrete use case.
- [ ] Relevant catalog metadata, source pins, licenses, and documentation are consistent.
- [ ] Installation behavior preserves unrelated and user-modified content.
- [ ] Known limitations and any required credentials or manual steps are documented.
